name: José R. Almonte
service_line_reviewed: Service reviewed: Appointed February 15, 2022 through September 13, 2026. Selected decisions: 4.

biography.text: Almonte earned his J.D. from Rutgers Law School and clerked for the New Jersey Supreme Court. His pre-bench career included private practice at Dechert, service as an Assistant U.S. Attorney in New Jersey—including Chief Counsel to the Criminal Division—and work as senior investigations counsel at Stryker. He joined the magistrate bench in 2022.
